narrationTexts: I'll start by searching the codebase.
finalText:
**Migrated 36 calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All 78 `.js` files pass `node --check`.

Left alone on purpose:

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (2 calls) | Header says do not edit, replaced on upgrade |
| `cache.query(...)` in 20 repos | Different API, not `db` |

Next: decide the vendor file. Options are a wrapper in `lib/` or an upstream patch.
